title: “Evaluation of the completeness of manual data entry when using the Intelli Space Critical Care and Anesthesia patient data management system.”
summary: Analysis of digital intraoperative anesthesia records with regard to completeness over time following initial training, taking into account potential influencing factors such as the duration of the procedure and the user’s professional experience.

interventions.name:
All patients who received general anesthesia in urology/general surgery
Distribution by department
-250 records per time period and department
Analysis period
-Initial training through 6 months after go-live (October 2022–March 2023)
- Training duration for 120 people was 2 months (prior to go-

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•    Age: 18 to 80 years
•    Elective surgeries in general surgery/urology
or
•    Emergency procedures in general surgery/urology with marked urgency
o    N00 – Surgery begins immediately in life-threatening situations
o    N01 – Surgery begins within 1 hour of notification
o    N06 – Surgery begins within 6 hours of notification
•    General anesthesia administered
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria:
•    Documented frequent staff changes (≥ 3 anesthesiologists involved) during procedures and the resulting uncertainty regarding which individual is responsible for the documentation in terms of professional experience. 
o    Exception: all anesthesiologists involved have the same level of training.  
•    Documentation performed exclusively by a nurse
•    Planned regional anesthesia/analgesic sedation alone
